quote_candidates.text: We forecast that over the next four years, global Internet and media revenues will grow by approximately $300 billion, continuing to outpace GDP growth
Access will lead revenue growth for tech and media companies
The digital premium video market is becoming more fragmented by the day — every player wants to be in everything
The future winners in television and video streaming will look quite familiar to consumers
Activate research indicates that half of the news reading population could subscribe to a news publication, up from 27% today
Sales of high-end devices will continue but we forecast that the cost of accessing a digital assistant will head to zero
For many categories, consumers will increasingly gravitate towards private labels, as platforms and retailers will favor discovery of their own products
